question_text: An open copper vessel of mass 20 kg is at a temperature of 150 $^\circ$C. Water of mass 0.1 kg at 20 $^\circ$C is poured into the vessel. The temperature of the mixture is 100 $^\circ$C. Assume that there is no loss of heat to the surroundings. (Take specific heat capacity of copper = 40 x 10$^2$ J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$; specific heat capacity of water 4.0 x 10$^3$ J kg$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$; specific latent heat of vaporization of water 2.5 x 10$^6$ J kg$^{-1}$)
